digest.component_or_area: example claude-skills TDD test-design standard + code-review tests criterion
propositions: The three example skills carry inline TDD prose that is under-specified on choosing the right test (no coverage inventory, tier rule, oracle guidance, fault-realism, or CI-gating proof).
Create a canonical shared test-design standard at examples/claude-skills/shared/test-design.md with byte-identical per-skill copies guarded by a drift-detecting unit test.
Integrate the shared standard into all three SKILL.md files, rebar-debug's llm-behavioral-taxonomy.md, and the examples README so each skill loads it at its testing point.

Add two uncovered antipatterns (non-gating test; unrealistic fault injection / sleep-only race sync) with false-positive guards to code-review-tests.md and extend the eval spec with recall and no-fire cases for both.
Held-out test discipline must be preserved mechanically: fixer/implementation subagent never sees held-out test code and hold-out language remains in both skills.
Plan-review E5, criteria_routing.json, and threshold/posture fields must remain untouched, with CI gates (lint, prompt-index drift, criteria-routing parity) staying green.
